name: Advanced Books
description: Advanced comic, manga, magazine and book features for Jellyfin 12, including Komga-compatible One-Shots and a localized Advanced Reader.
overview: Advanced comic, manga, magazine and book reader for Jellyfin 12.

versions.changelog: Add six-language localization for the Advanced Reader and plugin configuration: English, Japanese, German, French, Spanish and Simplified Chinese. Reader UI follows the Jellyfin/browser language automatically and keeps localized controls addressable through stable action identifiers. Add a repository-owned catalog icon and project banner, publish imageUrl and Books-category metadata in the Jellyfin repository manifest, and document repository-based installation and Catalog-discovered updates. Extend embedded-resource verification to the new localization bridge and add release validation for catalog metadata.

Fix a critical Continuous/Webtoon rendering race that could append duplicate page images to the same slot and display them side by side. Enforce a strict one-image-per-page DOM invariant with generation guards so stale asynchronous loads cannot resurrect evicted images. Make double-page spreads stable by determining page orientation before rendering instead of displaying a guessed spread and correcting it afterward. Ignore __MACOSX and AppleDouble image-like entries in CBZ/ZIP archives, disable browser caching for full-page responses, and verify the served page index in the Web reader. Add configurable reader metadata visibility for title, authors, series, issue and year, plus automatic overflow scrolling that can be enabled or disabled per Jellyfin user.

Show Jellyfin book title, authors, series and year in the Advanced Reader. Fix progress resume for played books and close-time/in-flight save races so the latest reached page is queued and synchronized reliably. Replace the desktop scrubber resize cursor with a normal pointer. Add Komga-style smart double-page spreads with first/last and landscape pages shown singly, persisted black/gray/ white backgrounds, optional page-transition animation, optional touch gestures, and contextual keyboard/gesture help. Keep the Core JavaScript below the JavaScript Injector size limit and extend preference schema migration/tests.

Harden JavaScript Injector startup recovery. Validate all embedded reader assets before replacing existing registrations, keep the required Core transactional, and allow optional Progress/Preferences/Navigator/Gestures bridges to fail soft without removing the rest of the reader. Log the actual loaded Advanced Books assembly version, informational version, and DLL path at startup. CI and release workflows now validate the five reader resources from the built plugin DLL itself with strict UTF-8 and size checks, in addition to source JavaScript checks.

Fix Page-grid thumbnails that could remain permanently unloaded after scrolling. Visible cards now use direct viewport scanning plus a watchdog, timeout recovery, 128px shared thumbnail caching, and a bounded two-request full-page fallback. Fix the scrub-preview loading layout so the spinner/error stays inside the thumbnail frame, replace the Advanced Reader launch glyph with a dedicated reader-mode icon, and improve mixed-size Vertical/Webtoon books with learned page aspect ratios, viewport-marker current-page tracking, explicit scroll anchoring, and preserved geometry across page eviction and viewport changes.

Improve desktop and mobile reader responsiveness. Use measured viewport sizing for Fit modes and migrate the legacy Fit Height default to Fit Screen, keep mobile controls square, anchor scrub previews to the active finger/pointer, reduce preview latency, cache archive metadata, and reuse compatible larger thumbnail cache entries. Stabilize Webtoon/Vertical scrolling with earlier and directional prefetch, decoded page geometry, and scroll-anchor compensation. Fix Pages-grid lazy loading with a viewport-priority queue and explicit scroll fallback, and isolate two-finger pinch zoom from page pan/scroll movement.

Fix Advanced Reader integration disappearing when the JavaScript Injector registration becomes corrupted. Register the reader core, progress, preferences, navigator, and gestures as five independent bounded scripts instead of one large combined payload. Remove the legacy combined entry on startup, validate embedded UTF-8/control characters, roll back partial registrations, and guard per-script size in CI and release validation.

Polish Advanced Reader interactions. Hidden chrome now ignores minor desktop pointer jitter, deliberate movement restores it, and hovering visible chrome pauses auto-hide. The page scrubber now shows a debounced authenticated thumbnail preview while dragging and stays pinned for long scrubs. Reduce GitHub Actions cost by deferring draft CI, cancelling stale PR runs, removing duplicate main CI builds, and triggering releases only from build.yaml changes.

Redesign the Advanced Reader UI for desktop and mobile. Add auto-hiding reader chrome, a direct page scrubber in every layout, responsive settings sheets, corrected Jellyfin detail-button markup, and an optional fullscreen toggle. Vertical Continuous and Webtoon now support fit controls, persisted zoom, side padding, page gaps, Ctrl+wheel zoom, two-finger pinch zoom, and desktop drag panning while retaining native one-finger scrolling.

Add dedicated two-finger pinch-to-zoom for paged Advanced Reader modes. Pinch gestures render a smooth live preview, suppress accidental page-turn swipes, and commit the final zoom through the reader's existing controls so persisted per-user zoom stays synchronized.
